title: Filter applied late in query instead of early
rationale: Filtering early reduces rows processed by later steps and can improve folding/performance.
evidence_required: M step order and folding state
review_note: Some later filters depend on columns created by prior steps.

title: Query folding broken early for a foldable source
rationale: For foldable sources, preserving query folding can significantly improve refresh performance.
review_note: CSV/Excel and other non-query-engine sources do not support folding.

title: Expensive operations performed before row/column reduction
rationale: Sorts, joins and complex transformations should generally occur after reducing unnecessary data.
review_note: Business logic may require the operation earlier.

title: Incorrect or delayed data type assignment
rationale: Correct data types support reliable transformations, model compression and semantics.
evidence_required: M type steps and model column types
review_note: Some sources intentionally delay typing until after parsing.

title: Large monolithic query with weak modularity
rationale: Splitting complex logic into understandable modules/functions can improve maintainability.
evidence_required: M code complexity and query dependencies
review_note: Excessive fragmentation can also hurt clarity; use judgment.

title: Repeated source logic that should be parameterized or reused
rationale: Parameters/functions can reduce duplication and make refresh logic easier to maintain.
review_note: Small stable queries may not benefit from abstraction.
